info.title: OHS Platform API
info.description: Versioned OHS business APIs. Public enquiries and account recovery, machine catalogue access, and delegated business workflows with authorization code and S256 PKCE. Private operations require current role, scope and record authorization. OpenID Connect is not implemented.

post.summary: Record a website enquiry and attempt immediate email delivery

example.name: Example sender
example.message: Please share information about OHS products.

201.description: Enquiry recorded with durable delivery intent. sent means SMTP acceptance, not confirmed inbox placement. pending includes retryable or ambiguous delivery requiring operational recovery. A replay returns the saved original response, not current delivery status. Scheduled recovery requires a hosting scheduler.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present when an idempotency key was supplied: true for replay, false for first submission.

429.description: Submission quota exceeded: 5 per minute and 30 per day per source IP.

500.description: Unexpected server failure. Retry only with the same Idempotency-Key and identical input; without a key an ambiguous retry can create another enquiry.

409.description: Idempotency key was already used with different input, or an identical request is still processing. Retry-After is present only for a processing conflict. No new enquiry is created.

Retry-After.description: For an identical in-flight request only, wait this many seconds before retrying the same key/input.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Recommended unique random key (for example UUIDv4). Scoped to this anonymous endpoint globally, not by IP. Retained for 24 hours from the first accepted request. Identical normalized input replays the saved 201 response without creating or sending again. Different input returns 409. An in-flight request returns 409 with Retry-After. Reuse after expiry can create a new enquiry. Without a key, requests are not deduplicated.

post.summary: Exchange reviewed machine credentials for a 15-minute token
post.description: Only client_credentials is enabled. Request explicit approved scopes. No refresh token is issued. Credentials must be kept on a server. Limit: 20 attempts per minute per source IP.

200.description: Access token issued. No refresh token or ID token is returned.

400.description: Invalid request/scope or unsupported grant. OAuth error format applies to token endpoint errors.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired machine access; disabled owner or revoked client.

403.description: Required scope is absent from token or current client approval.

429.description: 60 authenticated attempts per minute per client exceeded.
